values.note: Added to Nebraska Game and Parks' reservation system in April 2026; a search summary of NGPC's announcement (unread) says half the sites are reservable, up to 180 days ahead and through 2 p.m. the day before arrival, and the rest stay first-come. NGPC's 2025 rates grid still listed Enders without the reservations asterisk.

booking.source: https://www.osmondrepublican.com/article/4823,enders-buffalo-bill-sras-are-now-offering-camping-reservations (2026-04-21: 'Enders Reservoir State Recreation Area and Buffalo Bill State Recreation Area have been added to Nebraska Game and Parks' camping reservation system.'), read 2026-11-04; a newspaper, so reported

note: Large SRA on Enders Reservoir with several camping areas (Area A, Area B, Center Dam, Church Grove, Crappie Bay). Area A on the east shore beside Hwy 61 is the main developed area (~24-32 electric sites, shower house, modern restrooms, fish-cleaning station; road noise from the highway); Area B and Church Grove on the south shore have vault toilets; primitive beach camping at the Dam area. --Claude
summary: NGPC's own pages are blocked. A 2026-04-21 newspaper item confirms Enders joined NGPC's reservation system (half reservable, half FCFS per an unread NGPC release), so the stored booking stands, now as reported. Fees already recorded from the grid. Pin sits on the Hwy 61 entrance junction, not on a campground; a move to the Area A upper loop is proposed. Several areas 1-2 km+ apart with their own roads (split candidates, not split). Not waterfront left, with a contrary camper claim flagged.
flags: PIN (move proposed, weak): stored 40.43609,-101.52078 is the junction of Hwy 61 and the park's north entrance road - no sites there. Campendium's Area A point is 40.43215,-101.519695 (~440 m SSE). NAIP shows a developed loop with buildings (restrooms/playground) at ~40.4325,-101.5205, ~400 m S of the pin, which fits the 'upper campground' with playground a 2018 reviewer describes in Area A. Suggest 40.4325,-101.5205. A second cluster with ~10 RVs on short spurs sits ~240 m NW of the pin (~40.4372,-101.5232) by the north beach; I could not tell which named area it is (the area map PDFs are on the blocked site).

SPLIT CANDIDATES (measured, not split): Area A (east shore, entered from Hwy 61) and the north-beach cluster are ~550 m apart on the same road system - one campground. Center Dam is ~1.8 km south at the dam, reached by the dam road; Area B / Church Grove lie on the south shore across the lake, 1-2 km from Area A, on a separate road network from the west/south. Each of those is 1 km+ away with its own entrance; NGPC publishes separate area maps (Area A, Area B, Center Dam).

WATERFRONT (contrary claim, not upgraded): a Campendium reviewer (Oct 3, 2018) took 'the end space, #23 ... and paralleled the water for nice views' among the electric sites; the 2018 June reviewer: Area A 'parallels the highway'. On NAIP a shore road runs along the east bank west of the upper loop, but I could not make out pads or RVs on it, and the reservoir was drawn down (broad exposed sand between the old shoreline and the water). Without the area map I cannot place the electric sites against the water, so not waterfront stays; a read of the Area A map could earn lakeview.

LOW WATER: imagery shows a wide band of bare sand along the north and east shores (reservoir well below full pool); NGPC notices (search results, undated) describe ramps out of service for low water. No current level read.
BOOKING PLATFORM: stored 'operator' (derived); the state:NE row uses reserveamerica for NGPC's reservation system. I could not find Enders on ReserveAmerica to confirm, so left.
